title: 第1652章 无上实力第1651章 星帝中期
content_zh:
“咔嚓—轰隆隆！”
一声震彻混沌塔内外、响彻诸天星穹的大道爆鸣轰然炸开！第三重帝境壁垒应声崩碎、化为漫天道光碎屑，彻底消融于天地之间！
霎时间，诸天星道本源倾覆而下，无尽帝道精气如江海倒灌，千万道星辰神链、虚空道纹、光阴神则自混沌深处垂落，层层裹覆张皓旸的身躯。原本已然极致圆满的混沌道台，再度开启全方位的涅盘升华！
道台之上，星辰之力褪去凡韵，化作璀璨不灭的鸿蒙星辉；虚空奥义褪去缥缈，凝为亘古不动的混沌罡基；光阴纹路流转凝实，化作轮转万古的岁月神印。
三道至高大道彻底交融归一、相辅相成，勾勒出一尊凌驾四重天所有同阶的无上帝道根基，每一寸道台肌理都流淌着极致的帝威，每一缕道韵都蕴含着碾压万法的本源之力。
漫天异象席卷整座混沌塔！
塔内星河倒悬、昼夜逆轮转、时空反复折叠生灭，无尽帝辉冲天而起，穿透层层塔界壁垒，引得外界诸天星辰齐齐震颤、万道俯首朝拜。
张皓旸周身帝域疯狂扩张，从万里疆域暴涨至十万里之巨，域内星辰悬浮、岁月流转、虚实相生，自成一方独立混沌小天地，杀伐道则、防御道则、时空禁锢道则层层叠加、霸道绝伦。
至此，第三重突破圆满落幕！
张皓旸修为逆势狂飙，稳稳登临星帝后期之境！
这一步跨越，绝非简单的境界提升，而是质的蜕变、道的升华！寻常星帝后期仙人，道基多有瑕疵、本源损耗过半，帝域残缺、道则浅薄，需千锤百炼方能稳固根基。
但张皓旸此番突破，全程以无上底蕴碾压桎梏、以大道本源洗练道体，道基凝练如万古神山、厚重如鸿蒙深渊，无一丝虚浮、无半点破绽、无分毫本源损耗，根基之浑厚，远超四重天自古以来的所有星帝后期修士，堪称同阶无瑕帝基、万古唯一！
他的肉身再度完成终极帝化，真言混沌道体层层淬炼升华，万法不侵的本源之力彻底烙印血肉筋骨，帝境极致攻击、天道杀伐、大道诅咒皆难以伤其分毫，诸邪辟易、万术无效，肉身强度已然触摸四重天帝境肉身极致。
周身经脉拓宽数倍，柔韧坚韧、通达无碍，可承载远超同阶的浩瀚帝力，运转功法毫无滞涩，喷薄战力无穷无尽。
而最令人震撼的神魂蜕变，却在此刻骤然停滞！
并非张皓旸神魂底蕴不足，而是此方四重天天地层级有限，天道规则已然抵达承载极限！
他此前突破至星帝中期、巅峰修为时，神魂接连越级暴涨，早已提前登临四重天星帝巅峰神魂的极致顶点，触及了此方天地的神魂桎梏壁垒。如今修为冲破至星帝后期，神魂依旧被天地规则牢牢锁死在星帝巅峰层级，无法再做突破攀升。
但禁锢之下，并非停滞不前，而是极致的凝练与沉淀！
无尽溢散的帝道本源、时空道韵、星辰精气，尽数涌入他的识海神魂之中。原本已然澄澈如混沌、包罗万象的巅峰神魂，此刻如同被鸿蒙神火反复淬炼打磨。
神魂本体愈发晶莹剔透、璀璨无瑕，表面流转着淡淡的鸿蒙帝纹，每一缕神念都凝练如星辰神金，厚重、精纯、磅礴、威严，远超寻常初入星帝巅峰的神魂品质。

此前的巅峰神魂，是层级上的极致；如今历经后期帝境本源洗礼、天地规则打磨后的巅峰神魂，是底蕴上的圆满！
其神魂威压、洞察之力、控道之能、镇压之威，尽数暴涨数倍！
一念可洞悉十万里星河所有道则玄机，一念可镇封万千帝道神通，一念可勘破世间一切虚妄幻术。寻常星帝巅峰修士与之对视，瞬间便会神魂震颤、识海欲裂、道心崩颓，根本无法承受这等凝练到极致的无上神魂威压。
随之而来的，是全方位的战力碾压蜕变！
一身帝境神通尽数完成终极升华，星辰杀伐术、时空禁锢术、虚空寂灭道、光阴轮回功，每一式招式都蕴含后期帝境本源，威力暴涨十倍不止，杀伐凌厉霸道、防御无解无敌、禁锢万法难破。专属他的无上混沌帝域彻底圆满，域内时空由心掌控、岁月随意轮转、星辰随心杀伐，同阶修士入域即被镇压，跨境强敌入域亦被桎梏。
此刻的张皓旸，底蕴彻底碾压四重天所有星帝后期修士，稳压绝大多数老牌星帝巅峰强者！
即便是柳寒山那般坐拥万古积淀、无数秘境底蕴、毕生资源堆砌的老牌顶尖星帝巅峰，在他圆满无瑕的星帝后期修为、凝练极致的巅峰神魂、无解时空大道奥义的三重加持下，再无任何抗衡资本。无需避其锋芒、无需迂回周旋、无需遁走保命，正面可镇、强攻可斩、道法可灭！
混沌塔五层的惊天异象缓缓收敛，狂暴奔涌的帝威层层内敛，归于张皓旸身躯之内。
张皓旸于此寂灭空灵之中，缓缓睁开双眸，那双帝目囊括万古乾坤、尽藏混沌道机，极尽世间至高玄幻气象！
眸底深处，亿万星河生生灭灭、起落浮沉，亘古光阴轮转不息、溯往追来，寂灭锋芒内敛藏锋、镇锁万敌，曜世神光驱晦破暗、蕴养诸天，无数星辰道纹、光阴道印、虚空道韵纵横交织、缠绕流转，铺展出道法万千的无上盛景。
更有历经无数杀伐沉淀的岁月沧桑、承载鸿蒙初始的混沌本源、镇灭诸天万法的寂灭神威，三重至高道韵相融归一，蛰伏于瞳孔方寸之间。
双目开合，可引星河倾覆、可定时空沉浮、可镇万道朝拜，渊深无匹似万古无光的混沌深渊，静谧超然如鸿蒙初辟的原始天道，一举一动、一眸一阖，皆自带凌驾四重天众生的无上帝尊气度！
气息看似平淡无华、与世无争，实则肉身、道基、经脉、神魂、帝域、神通，尽数臻至四重天星帝层级的极致圆满，跨阶无敌的绝对底蕴彻底定型！
自此，四重天可以说再无能够桎梏他的星帝，清算天剑宗的柳寒山、荡平四重天祸乱、碾压一切宿敌的无上实力，已然具备！

content_en:
“Crack—boom!”
A loud bang that shook both inside and outside the Chaos Tower and resounded through the stars in the sky exploded with a bang! The third level of Imperial Realm barrier collapsed with a sound, turning into debris of Daolight all over the sky, completely dissolving between heaven and earth!
In an instant, the source of the stars in the sky overturned, and the endless imperial energy poured in like a river and sea. Thousands of star chains, void patterns, and time gods fell from the depths of chaos, covering Zhang Haoyang's body layer by layer. The Chaos Taoist platform, which was already extremely complete, once again started the all-round Nirvana sublimation!
On the Taoist platform, the power of the stars faded away from the ordinary charm and turned into the dazzling and immortal starlight; the profound meaning of the void faded away from the misty and condensed into the eternal base of chaos; the lines of time flowed and solidified, turning into the divine seal of time that rotates through the ages.
The three supreme avenues are completely integrated and complement each other, outlining the foundation of a godless Tao that surpasses all the same levels in the fourth heaven. Every inch of the Tao platform texture flows with the ultimate imperial power, and every ray of Tao rhyme contains the original power to crush all laws.
The sky is filled with strange phenomena that sweep across the entire Chaos Tower!
The stars in the tower hang upside down, day and night rotate in reverse, time and space repeatedly fold and die, and the endless imperial glow rises into the sky, penetrating the layers of tower barriers, causing the stars in the outside world to tremble in unison, and thousands of people to bow their heads in worship.
The imperial territory around Zhang Haoyang expanded crazily, from a territory of ten thousand miles to a hundred thousand miles. The stars in the territory were suspended, the years passed, and the virtual and the real were intertwined. It became an independent small world of chaos. The rules of killing, defense, and time and space were superimposed layer by layer, making it extremely domineering.
At this point, the third breakthrough has come to a successful conclusion!
Zhang Haoyang's cultivation level bucked the trend and soared, firmly reaching the late stage of the Star Emperor!
This step forward is by no means a simple improvement of realm, but a qualitative transformation and a sublimation of Tao! For ordinary immortals in the late stage of the Star Emperor, their Dao foundations are mostly flawed, their origins are more than half lost, their imperial domains are incomplete, and their Dao principles are shallow, and they need to be tempered many times before they can solidify their foundations.
But Zhang Haoyang's breakthrough this time, he used the supreme foundation to crush the shackles and refine the Tao body with the origin of the Tao. The Tao foundation is as condensed as the eternal sacred mountain and as thick as the Hongmeng Abyss. There is no trace of vanity, no flaws, and no loss of origin. The foundation is rich and profound, far exceeding all the late Star Emperor cultivators of the Fourth Heaven since ancient times. It can be called the flawless Imperial foundation of the same level, the only one in eternity!
His physical body once again completed the ultimate imperial transformation. The mantra of chaos was tempered and sublimated layer by layer. The invincible original power was completely imprinted on the flesh and bones. The ultimate attacks of the imperial realm, the killings of heaven, and the curses of the great avenue were all indestructible. All evils were warded off, and all spells were ineffective. The strength of his physical body had touched the extreme level of the fourth-level heavenly emperor's body.
The meridians all over the body are expanded several times, are flexible, tough, and accessible. They can carry vast imperial power that far exceeds the same level. The skills can be operated without any sluggishness, and the fighting power is endless.
But the most shocking transformation of the soul suddenly stopped at this moment!
It's not that Zhang Haoyang's spiritual soul is insufficient, but that the level of the fourth heaven and earth in this area is limited, and the rules of heaven have reached their limit!
When he broke through to the middle stage of Star Emperor and reached the peak cultivation level, his soul continued to skyrocket. He had already reached the ultimate peak of the fourth-level Star Emperor's peak soul in advance, touching the barrier of the soul in this world. Now that the cultivation level has reached the late stage of Star Emperor, the soul is still firmly locked at the peak level of Star Emperor by the rules of heaven and earth, and can no longer make breakthroughs and climbs.
But under the confinement, it is not stagnation, but the ultimate condensation and precipitation!
The endless overflowing origin of the imperial path, the rhythm of time and space, and the essence of the stars all poured into his sea of ​​consciousness soul. The peak soul, which was originally as clear as chaos and all-encompassing, now seems to have been repeatedly tempered and polished by the Hongmeng Divine Fire.
The body of the divine soul is becoming more and more crystal clear and brilliant, with a faint Hongmeng Emperor pattern flowing on the surface. Every ray of divine thought is condensed like star gold, thick, pure, majestic, and majestic, far exceeding the ordinary quality of the divine soul that has just reached the peak of the Star Emperor.
The previous peak soul was the ultimate in levels; now it has been baptized by the origin of the late emperor realm and polished by the rules of heaven and earth.The peak soul is the perfection of foundation!
The pressure of his soul, the power of insight, the ability to control the way, and the power of suppression have all increased several times!
One thought can penetrate all the mysteries of the laws of the galaxy a hundred thousand miles away, one thought can suppress the magical powers of thousands of emperors, and one thought can destroy all the illusions in the world. Ordinary Star Emperor cultivators at the peak of their gaze would instantly feel their souls tremble, their sea of ​​consciousness burst, and their Taoist hearts collapse when they looked at him. They simply could not withstand the pressure of such a supreme soul that was condensed to the extreme.
What follows is an all-round crushing transformation of combat power!
The ultimate sublimation of all the magical powers of the Emperor Realm, including the Star Killing Technique, Time and Space Confinement Technique, Void Nirvana Way, and Time Reincarnation Technique. Each move contains the origin of the late Emperor Realm. The power has increased more than ten times. The killing is fierce and domineering, the defense is invincible, and the imprisonment is difficult to break. His exclusive Supreme Chaos Imperial Domain is completely complete. The time and space in the domain are controlled by the heart, the years rotate at will, and the stars are killed at will. Monks of the same level will be suppressed when they enter the domain, and powerful cross-border enemies will also be shackled when they enter the domain.
At this moment, Zhang Haoyang's background completely overwhelms all the late-stage Star Emperor monks in the Fourth Heaven, and dominates most of the veteran Star Emperor's peak powerhouses!
Even Liu Hanshan, a veteran top star emperor who has accumulated eternal accumulation, countless secret realms, and a lifetime of resources, has no capital to compete with him under the triple blessing of his perfect and flawless late star emperor cultivation, the most condensed peak soul, and the secret of the unsolvable time and space avenue. There is no need to avoid its edge, no need to make detours, no need to run away to save your life, it can be suppressed head-on, attacked with force, and destroyed with Taoism!
The shocking phenomena on the fifth floor of the Chaos Tower slowly converged, and the violent surge of imperial power was restrained layer by layer, returning to Zhang Haoyang's body.
Zhang Haoyang slowly opened his eyes in this emptiness of silence. Those imperial eyes encompassed the eternal universe, hiding all the principles of chaos, and showing the highest fantasy atmosphere in the world!
Deep in the eyes, billions of galaxies are born and died, ups and downs, the eternal time cycle is endless, going back and forth, the edge of silence is introverted, suppressing all enemies, the divine light of the Yao Shi drives away the darkness, and nourishes the heavens. Countless star patterns, light and vagina seals, and void Dao rhymes are criss-crossed, intertwined, and circulated, unfolding the supreme scene of countless Taoisms.
What’s more, the vicissitudes of time that have gone through countless killings, the origin of chaos that carries the beginning of Hongmeng, the divine power of annihilation that suppresses all the laws of the heavens, and the three-level supreme Tao rhyme are integrated into one, dormant in the square inch of the pupil.
Opening and closing the eyes can lead the stars and rivers to overturn, determine the ups and downs of time and space, and control the worship of thousands of people. The abyss is as deep as the eternal lightless abyss of chaos. It is as quiet and transcendent as the original heavenly way established by Hongmeng. Every move, every eye is closed, and all have a god-less dignity that surpasses all living beings in the fourth heaven!
The aura seems to be ordinary and uncontested, but in fact, the physical body, Dao foundation, meridians, soul, imperial domain, and supernatural powers have all reached the ultimate perfection of the fourth-level Heavenly Star Emperor level, and the absolute foundation of cross-level invincibility has been completely finalized!
From then on, it can be said that there is no Star Emperor who can restrain him in the fourth heaven. He has the supreme strength to clean up Liu Hanshan of the Tianjian Sect, put an end to the chaos in the fourth heaven, and crush all old enemies!
